input: The pieces of sound a lane plays in a window around a cut (qnc-program-waveform placements: clip, camera channel, frames, level, off) and the preview's StillLocator (the stored sound streams of the clip's original on this machine).
output: A peak per column of the window, composed from the samples of those pieces read in the background through the decoder catalog, a second and a half around what is needed, kept in memory (6 chunks per clip channel); loading while anything is still being read.
specification: User 2026-10-25: cutting a letter or a short word needs the sound zoomed; the stored wave has 1200 points per clip. Shown by qnc-trim-overlay under the trim zoom's pictures with a thin line through the cut.
